definitions.explanation: Used to refer to the fifth day of a calendar month.
A span of five days, often in the form {五日間|いつかかん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧{五日|いつか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だ。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{五日|いつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting on the 5th of next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{五日|いつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧。
examples.english: My salary is deposited on the 5th of every month.

examples.japanese: {五日間|いつかかん}⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a five-day business trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{五日|いつか}⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Five days have passed since then.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{五日間|いつかかん}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: This year too the consecutive holidays are scheduled to last five days.

notes:
{五日|いつか} uses the native Japanese counting series for days 1–10 of the month: ⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧, ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧, ⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧, ⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧, {五日|いつか}, ⟦{六日|むいか}→六日：02973_muika⟧, ⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧, ⟦{八日|ようか}→八日：02983_youka⟧, ⟦{九日|ここのか}→九日：02901_kokonoka⟧, ⟦{十日|とおか}→十日：02917_tooka⟧. The same forms also count durations in days (except ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ for 'one day' as a duration).

DISAMBIGUATION:
Do not confuse with いつか (someday, sometime), which is written either in kana only or with kanji {何時|いつ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. The two are unrelated despite the identical reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧{五日|いつか}: May 5th (Children's Day)
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{五日|いつか}: the 5th of every month
- {五日間|いつかかん}: five-day period
